territories.name: Lao People's Democratic Republic
territories.legal_reference: Directive 2006/112/EC, article 5(2): the common system of VAT applies in the territory of the Community as defined by the Treaties, and a State outside it is a third country for every rule the Directive carries. The Lao People's Democratic Republic levies a value added tax of its own under the Law on Value Added Tax No. 48/NA of 2018: article 17 sets it at 10 per cent and zero-rates the export of goods, article 12 exempts the operations it lists, and article 30 has the taxpayer file the return by the 15th of the month following.
